properties.displayName: [FedRAMP High] Private Endpoint: DNS Zone Group Must Be Configured
properties.description: Audits Private Endpoints that do not have a DNS zone group configured. FedRAMP High requires boundary protection (SC-7) and secure name resolution (SC-20). Without a DNS zone group, the Private Endpoint's private IP address is not automatically registered in the Private DNS Zone, causing DNS resolution to fall back to the public endpoint and bypassing network isolation.

metadata.description: Audit: Report non-compliance for PEs without DNS zone group. Disabled: Do not evaluate.
